text:
tara: Quick profiling pass on Llama2-13B on rtx-a100 pool. Kernel selection flips to generic kernels at seq>1024 causing a perf cliff. Anyone seen this?

mike: saw that earlier. is this the fused attention kernel fallback?

tara: yes — logs show `kernel: attention_fused` up to 1024 then `kernel: attention_generic` beyond. snippet:
```
[profile] seq=512 kernel=attention_fused tps=920
[profile] seq=1280 kernel=attention_generic tps=540
```

sanjay: likely RoPE scaling churn — Mixtral tests had a similar cliff when RoPE loc-scaling kicked in. heads/kv dim alignment mattered there.

elaine: any changes in batching heuristics recently? we batch by token budget currently, long tails might break effective batching.

mike: current heuristic is token_budget = 4096, prefer_same_len=true. For long-tail requests we cap per_request_seq=1536 to avoid kernel fallback.

tara: ran a small sweep this morning. per-model quick findings:
- Llama2-13B: cap_seq=1024, prefer_fused=true -> ~15% p99 improvement
- Mistral-7B: cap_seq=1536, kv_dim_remap enabled -> much smoother throughput curve
- Mixtral-8x: lowering kernel_switch_threshold helped regain median tps
- Qwen-7B: rope_scale=0.9 for long-context scenarios avoids head misalignment on some kernels

kevin: what's kv_dim_remap? quick recap pls.

mike: kv_dim_remap pads/reshapes KV tensors to align with CUDA preferred dims (multiples of 32/64). reduces bank conflicts and avoids slow generic kernels. small mem cost but big perf win for certain dims.

tara: FYI perf CI flagged a regression on dedicated pool yesterday for Mixtral-8x after a kernel-selector tweak. infra-bot posted: 
infra-bot: [perf-ci] 1735980000 commit 0f9a caused -22% median tps for mixtral-8x at seq=2048 on dedicated-a100

sanjay: temporary mitigation: increase kernel_switch_threshold from 1280 -> 1536 for Mixtral. longer term we need kernel perf models keyed by (model, hw, seq_len).

elaine: KV cache behavior notes: reusing prefix KV across short sessions gave ~2x token/sec in our tests. but sticky KV increases memory pressure.

mike: we added heuristic: enable sticky_kv only if prefix_len>=256 AND reuse_prob>=0.6. avoids blowing memory on rare long-prefix requests.

tara: benchmark command used for sweep:
```
./perf_sweep --model llama2-13b --seqs 128,512,1024,1280 --batch_sizes 1,4,8 --metric tps --gpu a100
```

kevin: any recommended defaults to push to configs repo?

tara: proposing per-model defaults PR: 
- default.max_seq_cap = model_default_cap (llama2-13b:1024, mistral-7b:1536, mixtral-8x:1536, qwen-7b:2048)
- kernel_switch_margin = +10% favoring fused kernels on supported hw
- kv.sticky_threshold = 256
- batching.max_tokens_per_batch = 4096

mike: add a CI regression check: nightly sweep including seq=2048 for qwen and ensure tps >= baseline * 0.9. Also test batch sizes 1/4/8.

elaine: also we should record head_dim and kv_dim in model metadata. Qwen uses head_dim=128 vs Llama head_dim=64, that changes packing and preferred kernel sizes.

tara: action items summary:
1) mike: implement kernel perf model (by hw+model) - due next Thurs
2) tara: open PR for per-model default caps and kernel margins
3) kevin: add KV sticky telemetry and memory guardrails
4) infra-bot: schedule nightly perf sweep across Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen

sanjay: quick note on RoPE scaling: for LLaMA variants full RoPE with scale>1 shifts attention numerics and can change best kernel (some fused kernels assume certain position enc flows). test explicitly when toggling rope_scale.

tara: TL;DR: short-term lifts from adjusting kernel selector thresholds and KV sticky heuristics. medium-term: per-hw kernel perf model + recording head/kv dims in model metadata + CI sweeps. dropping notes into eng-runtime wiki now.

kevin: thanks all, will push canary config later today :thumbsup:
